blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Answerability readouts predict whether a passage supplies an answer, but whether calibration can compensate for removing negative passages during training remains unclear. We present a controlled study of how training-negative construction affects calibrated prediction, ranking, and downstream answer retention. We compare native training, which retains negative passages, with empty training, which removes them, holding questions, labels, positive examples, and model weights fixed. Both are calibrated on the same labeled native examples. On SQuAD 2.0 and RepLiQA, native-trained logistic readouts at selected depths achieve lower Brier loss for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Gemma-2-9B-it, with or without output scores. Native fusion also outperforms calibrated output alone. Post-hoc AUROC analysis shows better ranking under native training, beyond what threshold adjustment alone can explain. On the official SQuAD 2.0 development set, native readout policies improve F1 over empty policies but retain more answers to unanswerable questions. The advantage varies by estimator and depth, while RepLiQA's text shortcuts limit claims about contextual understanding. Unfinished generations prevent complete answer-level evaluation, although worst-case bounds preserve the native-empty F1 gains. Our findings show that training negatives affect ranking and downstream decisions even after common calibration, without establishing a universal advantage for native training.

blocks.en: 3 Related Work
blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en:
Hidden-state classifiers predict answerability ( Slobodkin et al., 2023 ) , and sparse-autoencoder studies examine
feature generalization for this task ( Heindrich et al., 2025 ) . Lavi et al. (2026) compare difference-in-means (DiM) and logistic readouts on four QA
datasets, including SQuAD 2.0 and RepLiQA, and find that validation-set threshold adjustment improves
cross-dataset transfer without changing the learned direction. Luo et al. (2026) study native and constructed negatives, including
document replacement and answer-sentence deletion, with label-free
quantile transfer thresholds.
We vary negative fitting passages and evaluate ranking and prediction
after calibration on identical labeled native examples.

blocks.en: 4 Background
blocks.zh: 4 背景情况

blocks.en:
Each QA example ( q i , c i , y i ) (q_{i},c_{i},y_{i}) contains a question, a passage,
and a dataset label y i ∈ { 0 , 1 } y_{i}\in\{0,1\} . The label is 1 when the passage
supplies an answer. The formatted prompt x i x_{i} requests a supported answer
or a fixed abstention response when the passage supplies no answer.
SQuAD requests the shortest copied span,
whereas RepLiQA allows a short paraphrase. Labels describe passage support
regardless of the model’s generated answer. Appendix A.1 gives both templates.

Passage support and answer correctness are distinct targets:
sufficient context does not ensure successful model use ( Joren et al., 2025 ) , and answerability and correctness signals
can support different abstention decisions ( Wagner, 2026 ) .
Probe research also distinguishes selectivity from accuracy ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) and decodability from model use ( Belinkov, 2022 ) .
We interpret readout performance as predictive access to passage
answerability, without inferring how the model uses that signal.

可以支持不同的弃权决定(Wagner,2026).
探测研究还区分了选择性与精度(Hewitt和Liang,2019年)和可解码性与模型使用(Belinkov,2022年).
我们把读出性能理解为可以预测通过
可答性,而不推断模型如何使用该信号.

A lower Brier loss can reflect less miscalibration or better
discrimination. Murphy’s decomposition separates reliability, resolution,
and uncertainty ( Murphy, 1973 ) . We use the CORP isotonic
decomposition ( Dimitriadis et al., 2021 ) , whose miscalibration (MCB) and
discrimination (DSC) terms correspond in role to reliability and resolution,
respectively, without necessarily matching their numerical values.
Its evaluation-label fit is descriptive and is never deployed as a
correction (Appendix B.3 ).

split for answer-level evaluation. Probability evaluation uses 164 new
articles from the training release, totaling 1,312 class-balanced inputs.
The six SQuAD components use different assignments of a 48-article
pool. Each component separates weight fitting from probability calibration,
but components overlap and share depth selection on the full pool.
We average their probabilities on new articles without refitting.
RepLiQA contains human-created fictional documents. We use its
first released split with 256 new evaluation documents and
1,280 questions, including 1,020 answerable and 260 unanswerable questions.
Both conditions share fitting and calibration assignments within each study.
The studies use different fitting protocols and class proportions, so we
report them separately rather than pool their effects. We exclude evaluation
texts from fitting, selection, calibration, and earlier diagnostics.

blocks.en:
Evaluating how readouts rank answerable inputs against native

blocks.en:
At the selected depths, native-trained logistic readouts

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Scope and identification. Our evidence covers two instruction-tuned models and two English QA
datasets with different fitting protocols and class proportions.
Removing negative passages changes content, length, and text
presence together, so the comparison does not isolate their separate effects.
The evaluation texts were unused in our earlier experiments, but
pretraining exposure or semantic overlap remains possible.
blocks.zh:
范围和识别。 我们的证据包括两个校正模型和两个英语QA
具有不同配对协议和类比例的数据集。
删除负面段落更改内容、长度和文本
存在,因此比较不会孤立它们各自产生的效果。
我们之前的实验没有使用评估文本,但
预训接触或语义重叠仍然是可能的。

blocks.en:
Selection and statistical uncertainty. We examine linear readouts at one token position and select a shared
depth from four candidates using native validation labels for both
training conditions. This design does not bound the best attainable
readout performance. Intervals condition on fixed fits and calibration
samples, excluding refitting and depth-selection uncertainty.
The models also share evaluation questions, so they are not independent
replications of the sampled data.

blocks.en:

and uses AI-assisted content review without independent human validation.
Its lexical shortcuts, and those found in RepLiQA, limit
what high accuracy establishes about contextual understanding.
Predictive access does not identify how the model uses evidence.

blocks.en: E.2 Fitting and Threshold Calibration
blocks.zh: E.2 装配和阈值校正

blocks.en:
Each fit uses seven development scenarios, with 84 positive and
84 negative examples. Because these fits overlap, we do not treat them
as independent samples.
blocks.zh:
每种情况都采用7个发展情景,其中84个为正、
84个负面例子。 因为这些重叠,我们不处理它们
作为独立的样本。

blocks.en:
Logistic regression
standardizes coordinates using fitting-set means and standard deviations,
then uses L2 regularization with C = 1 C=1 , the L-BFGS solver,
a 2,000-iteration limit, and random seed 20260917. DiM uses the normalized raw
class-mean difference and centers scores at the overall fitting mean.
blocks.zh:
后勤回归
使用安装手段和标准偏差使坐标标准化,
然后使用C=1 C=1的L2正规化,L-BFGS解决器,
入地限为2000个入地限,随机种子为20260917个出地限. DIM 使用正则原始
班级的差别和中枢的得分 在整体合适的平均值。

blocks.en:
For both estimators, the training threshold maximizes BA on the fitting
examples. Predictions are positive only when the score strictly exceeds
the threshold. Candidate thresholds are the distinct fitting scores and
the next representable value below their minimum, covering all-positive
and all-negative decisions. Ties in BA favor the larger threshold.
blocks.zh:
对两个估算者来说,培训门槛在适应性上达到最大BA
实例。 预测只有在得分严格超过时才为正数
门槛。 候选人的门槛值是不同的适当分数和
低于最小值的下一个可代表值,涵盖所有阳性
和所有负面的决定。 BA的铁链支持更大的门槛。

blocks.en:
Common threshold calibration partitions scenarios into two deterministic
12-scenario halves, selects the BA-maximizing threshold on one half,
and evaluates the other before swapping their roles. We never reverse
score signs using test labels. The main text averages over the
dependent fits. Bootstrap diagnostics resample scenarios, with fits
and calibration halves held fixed.
blocks.zh:
共同阈值校准分区方案分为两种确定性方案
十二分之一,选择BA-最大阈值的一半,
并在互换角色前评价对方。 我们从不颠倒
使用测试标签的分数标志。 主文平均数
所依赖的适合。 靴子诊断方法 复选方案
并固定一半。

blocks.en:
CPU replay uses saved records, without new model inference, independent
rescoring of generated text, or refitting every historical diagnostic.
The package excludes model weights, activation caches, and raw text,
but includes source identifiers, model revisions, hashes,
unfinished-generation flags, and scoring and sensitivity rules.
blocks.zh:
CPU 重放使用已保存的记录, 没有新的模型推断, 独立
重新评分生成的文本,或者重排每个历史诊断.
软件包不包括模型权重、激活缓存和原始文本,
但包括源识别符、模型修订、散列、
未完成的一代旗帜, 和评分和敏感规则。
